title: Queued edit delivery inherits the slow source scan interval
wanted_capability: Poll lightweight admitted gap and knowledge edits promptly without increasing expensive source scans or publication frequency.
notes: Queued edit delivery now polls independently every 10 seconds; source scans retain their configured cadence.
resolution_note: Native collector source 78fef2f6 passed 22 lane tests and dependency ceiling check, was stablesigned and deployed. A live admitted update reached the checkout in 8.12 seconds while source scans remained at 600 seconds.
